items.title: sponsorship answer: confirm saved answer before use
turns: An application asks whether I will need visa sponsorship. Use my saved answer, but confirm it with me first.
replies:
International-student realism — the cap, the exempt doors, and where the sponsor data lives.
The realistic picture, without sugarcoating. The H-1B route runs through a capped annual lottery with far more registrations than visas, so a cap-subject employer's willingness to sponsor is only half the battle — the lottery is the other half. Two structural facts work in your favor: cap-exempt employers — institutions of higher education, their affiliated nonprofits, and nonprofit or government research organizations — can petition year-round outside the cap entirely, and OPT (with the STEM extension for eligible degrees) gives you a work-authorized runway after graduation during which an employer can sponsor from evidence of your work.
Source: USCIS Policy Manual — students and employment, as of 2026-10-13. Tell me the employers on your list, and I will check each one's filing history against the Data Hub record with you.
